title: Node.js Developer
description:
About the Role Codes For Tomorrow is looking for an experienced Node.js Developer with 4+ years of experience who has strong expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, backend development, and API design. The ideal candidate should be capable of building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Node.js. Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code using JavaScript and TypeScript. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services. Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB. Optimize application performance, scalability, and security. Implement authentication, authorization, and data validation mechanisms. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues. Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure application reliability. Collaborate with frontend developers, designers, QA engineers, and other team members. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions. Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Follow coding standards, best practices, and development processes. Required Skills Experience: Minimum 4+ years of professional backend development experience. Node.js: Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and backend application development. JavaScript: Excellent understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+). TypeScript: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and type-safe application development. Frameworks: Experience with Express.js or similar Node.js frameworks. APIs: Strong knowledge of REST API development and integration. Databases: Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases. Version Control: Proficiency with Git and GitHub. Testing: Familiarity with unit testing, integration testing, and debugging. Security: Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices. Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems. Experience with Redis, message queues, or background job processing. Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies. What Were Looking For A proactive developer with strong technical and problem-solving abilities. Someone who can independently manage development tasks and deliver quality code. A team player with good communication and collaboration skills. A professional who stays updated with modern backend technologies and industry best practices.

Key Skills: Javascript,CI Cd Pipeline,MongoDB,Docker,AWS,Continuous Integration,MySQL,Node.js
